name: Shihoro (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shihoro town emblem in red and green: a red ring open at the bottom beneath a green triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Shihoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 12 July 1968.

features.role: Shihoro town emblem — a red ring open at the bottom beneath a green triangle
